issues.detail: The Greek 'οπως ελθη' (as/how it comes) is rendered as 'sẽ đổ lại' (will flow back). The Vietnamese adds 'lại' (back), which implies a return or recurrence not present in the Greek text. Furthermore, the Greek describes the blood *coming* out (flowing) on the earth, while the Vietnamese phrasing suggests a future consequence of the blood flowing back onto them.
